name: token-efficient-scripts
description: Write throwaway bash/python for one-off file & data tasks so they cost minimal tokens and run fast. Also covers recovering from a failed command without paying for a man page. Ships a PreToolUse hook that actually blocks an unfiltered `man` and hands back the cheaper ladder. Also covers asking tests, builds, git and archive tools for their verdict instead of their log. Bundles the skill, /bench, /bench-recovery and /bench-verify commands that re-run the benchmarks and log new findings, and a stop hook.
